components.name: Accordion
components.summary: a native `<details>`/`<summary>` disclosure list, generalizing `Faq`'s pattern to any trigger/content pair. `type="single"` gets mutual-exclusivity for free from the native `<details name>` group (broadly supported); no JS, no state, fully server-safe. Zero dependencies (ADR-0291).

props.name: type
props.doc: Multiple items may be open at once (default) — no cross-item coordination needed. Only one item open at a time, via the native `<details name>` exclusive-group — free, no JS. `name` must be unique per Accordion instance on the page (it is a document-wide grouping key), so it is required rather than defaulted.

components.name: AppShell
components.summary: an adopter-dashboard frame with responsive primary navigation, a persistent top bar, and a scrollable main-content landmark. Recipe-compliant (ADR-0099): co-located CSS reading only `var(--cs-*)`, `data-collapsed` / `data-mobile-nav-open` variants, BEM block `cs-shell`. `"use client"` (collapse + mobile-drawer state).

props.name: brand
props.doc: Brand slot rendered top-left. Optional and brand-neutral — the kit ships no default mark; the consumer passes its own (e.g. `<Wordmark />` from `@caisson-sh/brand`).

props.name: children
props.doc: Main content region.

props.name: mobileNavFooter
props.doc: Extra content rendered inside the mobile off-canvas drawer only (CSS ≤48rem; invisible on desktop) — e.g. a Sign-out control the topbar can't always spare room for on a narrow viewport. Typically the same or a subset of what `topBar` already renders.

props.name: nav
props.doc: Left-sidebar navigation items.

props.name: renderNavItem
props.doc: Override how each nav item renders (e.g. a Next.js `<Link>`); defaults to a plain `<a href>` so the kit stays framework-agnostic.

props.name: topBar
props.doc: Top-bar content — account menu / actions. Right-aligned.

a11yNotes: The mobile-nav and collapse controls expose their state with `aria-expanded` or `aria-pressed`; the sidebar and main region retain native landmark semantics.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: a compact solid-fill tag for counts, categories, and short labels (e.g. a module's category chip in a card grid, a cart-item count). Sibling to `StatusChip` (glyph + label, entitlement-flavored tones) but generic: no icon slot, no dot, just text — the kit's plain "tag" primitive the audit flagged as a gap.

props.name: tone
props.doc: Semantic tone → a local-indirection `--badge-fg` var (recipe rule 3). Defaults to `neutral`.

components.name: BundleCard
components.summary: a featured-lead bundle link (V12; renamed from EditionCard when the editions dissolved into the six-bundle catalog, ADR-0257/0258), ported from the inline-style `apps/site` primitive to the recipe (ADR-0099): co-located CSS reading only `var(--cs-*)`, the `lead` variant expressed as the `data-lead` attribute, and a self-contained `.cs-edition` surface that replicates the interactive-card tonal hover + lift (no dependency on the sibling `card`). The `.cs-edition*` class names are part of the shipped CSS contract and stay unchanged.

props.name: href
props.doc: Destination — BundleCard is ALWAYS a link, so it renders a plain `<a href>` (no framework).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Domain glyph (Lucide / bespoke) via the one `<Icon>` surface — rendered at `size="lg"`.

props.name: lead
props.doc: Featured-lead hierarchy (V12): spans the full grid row + accent border/tint.

props.name: line
props.doc: One-line description under the head.

props.name: name
props.doc: Bundle display name (rendered beside the glyph in the head).

props.name: proof
props.doc: One-line mono proof artifact (V8) — e.g. a CLI/CI line.

props.name: status
props.doc: A `<StatusChip>`/badge node shown at the right of the head.

a11yNotes: Always renders a native anchor, so its full card content forms one keyboard-reachable link.

components.name: Button
components.summary: a primary or ghost action control with small/medium sizing and optional Radix Slot polymorphism. Recipe REFERENCE component (ADR-0099) — the template every other kit primitive copies: 1. Radix behavior/polymorphism (here `Slot` for `asChild`); never a framework import. 2. Co-located plain CSS (`button.css`) reading only `var(--cs-*)`. 3. Variants as `data-*` attributes styled by attribute selectors — no variant logic in JS; light/dark "just works" by cascade. 4. `forwardRef`, BEM block name `cs-button`.

props.name: asChild
props.doc: Render as the single child element instead of a `<button>` (Radix Slot). This is the framework-agnostic navigation seam: a Next consumer writes `<Button asChild><Link href="/x">…</Link></Button>` so `@caisson-sh/ui` never imports `next/link`. The child must accept `className` + `data-*` (Slot merges the kit's props onto it).

props.name: variant
props.doc: Visual weight: `primary` = accent fill (one of the ≤10% accent slots), `ghost` = hairline.

a11yNotes: Native buttons default to `type="button"` to prevent accidental form submission; with `asChild`, the caller owns the slotted element's native semantics and accessible name.

components.name: Card
components.summary: presentational panel primitive following the kit's shared component recipe: co-located CSS + data-* attribute variants, no bespoke styling (ADR-0099). Renders a single `<div>`, so it is server-safe and `forwardRef`s its DOM root. No Radix: a card never navigates or toggles. - `accent` → `data-accent` (boolean attribute), `interactive` → `data-interactive`; both styled by attribute selectors in `card.css` — no variant logic in JS. - Co-located CSS reads only `var(--cs-*)`; BEM block `cs-card`.

props.name: accent
props.doc: Accent treatment — accent border + tinted surface (one of the ≤10% accent slots).

props.name: interactive
props.doc: Tonal-hover affordance: border brighten + surface step + lift (motion-tokened).

a11yNotes: The root is a presentational `div` with no implicit role; interactive content must remain a real control or link supplied by the caller.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: a hand-rolled checkbox with a real `<input type="checkbox">` for semantics/keyboard (layered full-bleed and transparent over the decorative box, so the whole ≥24px box is the hit target) plus a CSS-driven check mark (`:checked` sibling selector — no JS state). Zero-Radix, zero dependencies (ADR-0291): the "check" glyph reuses the kit's existing `<Icon>` surface.

props.name: label
props.doc: Trailing label text/content. Omit to render the bare control (caller supplies its own `<label>`, e.g. wrapping a custom layout).

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Recipe primitive (ADR-0099) — purely presentational, server-safe (no hook/handler/browser API, so no `"use client"`). Two shapes from one prop API: - `frame` → defers to the sibling `<Terminal>` primitive (chrome bar + body); terminal classes are owned there, never redefined here. - default → a `<pre class="cs-code">` (the always-dark code surface) inside a non-scrolling `.cs-code-frame` wrapper that pins the right-edge scroll-shadow affordance in place. No `forwardRef`: the component branches between two roots (a `<Terminal>` wrapper vs a `.cs-code-frame` div), so there is no single stable DOM root to forward a ref to — unlike the `Button` reference.

props.name: code
props.doc: The code body. String or tinted `ReactNode` — compose `<span className="cs-tok-danger">` (etc.) for load-bearing tokens that must read as danger/accent/muted.

props.name: frame
props.doc: Wrap the code in terminal chrome (`<Terminal>`) instead of a bare `<pre>`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible label; also the chrome-bar title when `frame` is set (defaults to `"shell"`).

props.name: status
props.doc: A `<StatusChip />` or text rendered in the terminal chrome bar (only when `frame`).

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.summary: a basic confirm/cancel prompt on the native-`<dialog>` `Dialog` primitive (focus trap, Escape, focus-return for free). Cancel is the escape hatch (Escape/backdrop also cancel); the confirm action carries the `danger` tone for destructive actions. For a retype-the-name armed confirmation, the commercial `TypeToConfirm` layers on this shape.

props.name: busy
props.doc: Confirm is disabled + labelled busy while an async action runs.

props.name: message
props.doc: Body copy explaining the consequence.

props.name: tone
props.doc: `danger` tints the confirm action for a destructive/irreversible action.

components.name: CopyField
components.summary: a read-only value with a one-click copy button. Writes to the clipboard and flips to a "Copied" confirmation for ~1.5s (announced via `role="status"`). The value box is a read-only input so the text is selectable and screen-reader reachable; `secret` masks it until copied.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name for the field + copy button context (e.g. "API key").

props.name: mono
props.doc: Render the value in the mono face (keys, ids, hashes). Default true.

props.name: secret
props.doc: Mask the value (dots) until copied — for secrets.

props.name: value
props.doc: The value shown and copied.

components.name: CredentialStrip
components.summary: CredentialStrip (V7) — presentational compliance-framework strip. Recipe primitive (ADR-0099): - No Radix (no behavior/polymorphism), no `"use client"` (server-safe, no hook/handler). - Co-located plain CSS (`credential-strip.css`) reading only `var(--cs-*)`. - BEM block `cs-credentials` / elements `__item` `__sep` `__note`. No inline style. - `forwardRef` on the single `<div>` root, mirroring the Button reference shape.

props.name: items
props.doc: Framework names rendered inline, separated by a leading "·" from the second item on.

props.name: note
props.doc: Optional trailing note; wraps onto its own full-width row in muted text.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: typed generic columns (`{ key, header, render }`) + rows, with built-in `loading` (skeleton) and empty states already wired in. Numeric columns right-align with tabular figures.

props.name: dense
props.doc: Tighten padding + shrink type for data-heavy grids.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Rendered in place of the table body when `rows` is empty and not `loading`. Defaults to a generic `<EmptyState>`.

props.name: filter
props.doc: Controlled filter text (paired with `onFilterChange`).

props.name: filterable
props.doc: Render a search box above the table. Filters rows whose `searchText` (or any sortable column's `sortValue`) contains `filter`, case-insensitively.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Renders the built-in `LoadingState` (table variant) in place of `rows`.

props.name: loadingRows
props.doc: Skeleton row count while `loading`. Default 5.

props.name: onSortToggle
props.doc: Header click handler; receives the clicked column key. Cycle asc→desc→null in the parent.

props.name: page
props.doc: Current 0-indexed page (controlled). Default 0.

props.name: pageSize
props.doc: Enable pagination at this page size. Rows are the post-filter/post-sort set.

props.name: rowKey
props.doc: Stable row key extractor.

props.name: searchText
props.doc: Extra searchable text per row (in addition to sortable columns).

props.name: sort
props.doc: Current sort (controlled). The matching column's header shows the direction and carries `aria-sort`; rows are ordered by that column's `sortValue` during render. Pair with `onSortToggle` for interactivity, or set it statically for a server-sorted view.

components.name: DetailList
components.summary: a semantic `<dl>` of term/value rows, the shared shape for the key-value and link-row detail panels hand-rolled across dashboards. A row with `href` renders its value as a link. Use `columns` for a label-left / value-right record, `stacked` for a scannable read.

props.name: layout
props.doc: Stack term-over-value (default) or lay them out in two columns.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: a modal or edge-drawer built on the native `<dialog>` element opened with `showModal()`, which supplies the focus trap, Escape-to-close, inert background, and focus-return that a hand-rolled `role="dialog"` div lacks (WCAG 2.4.11 / 2.1.2). Driven by the `open` prop; a backdrop click or Escape calls `onClose`. The close button and title live in a default header unless `hideHeader` is set.

props.name: className
props.doc: Extra class merged onto the `<dialog>` element, for a consumer-specific override (e.g. an app pinning the drawer below its own fixed header).

props.name: hideHeader
props.doc: Hide the default header (title + close button) to supply a fully custom body.

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Called when the dialog closes (Escape, backdrop click, or the close button).

props.name: open
props.doc: Open/closed (controlled). Driven onto the native `<dialog>` via `showModal()`/`close()`.

props.name: side
props.doc: Which edge the drawer slides from. Ignored for `modal`. Default "right". "top" is a full-width sheet capped to content height instead of a full-height side column — the shape a nav drawer under a fixed header bar wants.

props.name: title
props.doc: Accessible title, shown in the header and used as the dialog's `aria-label`.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Centered modal (default) or an edge sheet.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: the calm "nothing here yet" affordance for empty tables, lists, and search results (one of the three async states with `LoadingState` / `ErrorState`). `DataTable` renders this internally when `rows` is empty and not `loading`.

props.name: action
props.doc: Optional call-to-action slot (e.g. a `<Button>`).

props.name: description
props.doc: Optional supporting line under the title (muted).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Leading glyph, centered in a soft tinted circle. Default `"inbox"`; pass `null` to omit.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline — what is empty, in plain English.

a11yNotes: The decorative leading icon is `aria-hidden`; the visible title and description carry the empty-state meaning as text.

components.name: ErrorState
components.summary: the calm failure affordance for a failed fetch / thrown read (one of the three async states with `LoadingState` / `EmptyState`). A centered column: a tinted warning glyph, a plain-English title, a reassuring description, and an optional retry action.

props.name: action
props.doc: Optional action slot (e.g. a retry `<Button>`).

props.name: description
props.doc: Supporting line; lead with reassurance, one next step.

props.name: icon
props.doc: Leading glyph. Default `"alert-triangle"`; pass `null` to omit.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline — what failed, in plain English. Default "Something went wrong".

components.name: Faq
components.summary: a native `<details>`/`<summary>` disclosure list, following the kit's shared component recipe of co-located CSS + no bespoke styling (ADR-0099). Replaces the two divergent hand-rolled FAQ renders (a `Card`-grid on some pages, a bare flex-`div` on others) with ONE accessible primitive: keyboard focus, screen-reader semantics, and a no-JS toggle come free from `<details>`. Server-safe (no hooks/handlers). BEM block `cs-faq`; co-located CSS reads only `var(--cs-*)`. Visible-FAQ rendering only — a page's `faqPage` JSON-LD stays where it is.

props.name: defaultOpenFirst
props.doc: Open the first item by default (e.g. a lead FAQ). Off by default.

components.name: FeatureGrid
components.summary: the shared responsive card/feature grid, following the kit's shared component recipe of co-located CSS + no bespoke styling (ADR-0099). Collapses the hand-duplicated `<div className="cs-grid cs-grid--N" style={{ marginTop }}>` pattern into one primitive: it reuses the existing kit-gated `cs-grid`/`cs-grid--N` layout (styles/base.css) and layers the standard top margin (skippable via `flush`). Server-safe; values via `var(--cs-*)`.

props.name: cols
props.doc: Column count at the widest breakpoint (collapses to 1 on narrow viewports). Default 2.

props.name: flush
props.doc: Drop the default top margin when the parent `Section` already supplies the rhythm.

a11yNotes: The grid wrapper is layout-only and adds no role, so each child retains its own native heading, link, or control semantics.

components.name: FormField
components.summary: label + control + helper/error, the one shape the dashboard's hand-rolled forms (BYOK key entry, add-a-seat, compliance attestation) all share. Consolidates the duplicated inline `fieldStyle` objects those forms each re-declared.

props.name: children
props.doc: The single form control — an `<input>`, `<select>`, or `<textarea>`. It receives `id`, `aria-describedby`, and `aria-invalid` via Radix `Slot` (the same seam `Button`'s `asChild` uses) so the label and helper/error text associate correctly for assistive tech without every call site wiring it by hand.

props.name: error
props.doc: Validation failure message. Swaps in for `helperText`, marks the control `aria-invalid`, and is announced via `role="alert"`.

props.name: helperText
props.doc: Supporting copy shown under the control. Hidden while `error` is set — the error takes its place so the two never compete for the same line.

props.name: label
props.doc: The field's visible label text.

props.name: mono
props.doc: Render the control in the brand's control-ID monospace (Martian Mono, DESIGN.md §3) — for id/key/token-shaped fields, not free-text notes. Default `false`.

components.name: Hero
components.summary: the split marketing header (V1). Recipe primitive (ADR-0099): 1. Purely presentational → no Radix, no framework import; server-safe (no hooks/handlers). 2. Co-located plain CSS (`hero.css`) reading only `var(--cs-*)`. 3. Layout + spacing live in CSS classes — every former inline `style={{…}}` is now a co-located class (`cs-hero__title` / `cs-hero__lede` / `cs-hero__credentials`). 4. `forwardRef` onto the single `<section>` root; BEM block `cs-hero`.

props.name: artifact
props.doc: The framed evidence artifact filling the right half (a `<Terminal/>`).

a11yNotes: Renders a semantic `section` with the supplied title as its `h1`; caller-provided actions retain their native link or button semantics.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: the one glyph surface for Lucide icons and registered Caisson domain marks. Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology by default; supplying `aria-label` promotes the SVG to a named `img`. The fixed size union is expressed through `data-size` for token-driven CSS.
a11yNotes: Omit `aria-label` for decorative glyphs; provide it to expose a named image.

components.name: LedgerList
components.summary: the credit-ledger transaction list. A muted column head plus one `<LedgerRow>` per entry, with the built-in `loading` (skeleton) and empty states already wired in.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Rendered when `entries` is empty and not `loading`. Defaults to a generic `<EmptyState>`.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Renders the built-in `LoadingState` (list variant) in place of `entries`.

props.name: loadingRows
props.doc: Skeleton row count while `loading`. Default 5.

props.name: unit
props.doc: Display unit for every row's delta/balance. Default `"credits"`.

a11yNotes: The visual column header is `aria-hidden`; each transaction's date, reason, amount, and balance remain readable in DOM order.

components.name: LoadingState
components.summary: the kit's async skeleton (one of the three async states with `EmptyState` / `ErrorState`). `DataTable` renders this internally while `loading`; views may also mount it directly above their own layout.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Column count for `table`. Default 4.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible busy label, announced to screen readers. Default "Loading".

props.name: rows
props.doc: Row count for `table` / `list`. Default 5.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Layout this skeleton stands in for, so it occupies the same shape as the real content and avoids layout shift once data arrives. Default `block`.

components.name: MetricStat
components.summary: a single dashboard stat tile (credits balance, entitlement count, …). A small muted label, a large value in tabular figures, and an optional hint/delta line. `tone` tints the value + icon via tokens only, never a TS light/dark branch.

props.name: hint
props.doc: Optional supporting line below the value (a delta, qualifier, or caption).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional leading glyph via the one `<Icon>` surface, tinted to match `tone`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Small muted caption above the value (what is being measured).

props.name: tone
props.doc: Semantic register for the value + icon. Default `default`.

props.name: value
props.doc: The headline figure, rendered large in tabular numerics (e.g. a `<MoneyCell>`).

components.name: MobileBuyBar
components.summary: Presentational recipe component (ADR-0099) — a persistent price + purchase bar pinned to the mobile viewport bottom, for a page whose full purchase card sinks below other content once the responsive grid collapses to one column (a long page's sticky sidebar rail only exists above that breakpoint). Always rendered — never conditionally mounted — so there is no hydration mismatch; visibility below the breakpoint is a pure CSS media query, the same pattern the rest of the kit uses for mobile-only chrome. No Radix: this never navigates or toggles, it only displays the caller's own action element (BEM block `cs-mobile-buy-bar`, co-located CSS reads only `var(--cs-*)`).

props.name: action
props.doc: The purchase action, typically an Add-to-cart button — passed through as-is, never re-implemented here.

props.name: label
props.doc: The item being purchased (e.g. a module or bundle name) — the same label the full purchase card shows.

props.name: price
props.doc: An already-formatted price string (e.g. "$149"), matching the full purchase card's own formatter.

components.name: MoneyCell
components.summary: renders an INTEGER credit/cent value via `formatMoneyCellValue` (ADR-0007). Purely presentational: no parsing, no inline editing — `DataTable` / `LedgerRow` cells compose it read-only.

props.name: sign
props.doc: Prefix non-negative values with a leading `+` (reconciliation / ledger diffs).

props.name: signTone
props.doc: Color the figure by its own sign (positive = success, negative = danger) — for ledger deltas. Default `false` (neutral foreground).

props.name: unit
props.doc: Display unit. Default `"usd-cents"`.

props.name: value
props.doc: Integer value in the unit's smallest denomination (cents for `usd-cents`, whole units for `credits`). Never a float (ADR-0007).

a11yNotes: The integer amount is always rendered as text; `data-sign` only adds visual tone and never carries the sign as color alone.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: an accessible page selector for tables and lists. Directive-free and hooks-free, so it renders in a server tree AS-IS; supply `onPageChange` from a client parent for interactivity. Prev/Next are disabled at the ends; the current page carries `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name for the nav landmark. Default "Pagination".

props.name: onPageChange
props.doc: Called with the next 0-indexed page. Omit for a static (server-rendered) pager.

props.name: page
props.doc: Current page, 0-indexed.

props.name: pageCount
props.doc: Total number of pages (>= 1).

props.name: siblingCount
props.doc: Max number buttons to show around the current page. Default 5.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: a hand-rolled radio button: a real `<input type="radio">` (semantics/keyboard/native grouping via `name`) layered full-bleed over a decorative circle, with a CSS `:checked` sibling selector drawing the filled dot — no JS state. Zero-Radix, zero dependencies (ADR-0291).

props.name: label
props.doc: Trailing label text/content. Omit to render the bare control.

components.name: Reveal
components.summary: Fade-up-once scroll reveal (recipe kit port of the old `apps/site` primitive, ADR-0099).

props.name: as
props.doc: Polymorphic root tag. Default `div`.

props.name: delay
props.doc: Per-instance stagger, ms. Applied as `transitionDelay` — map an index over siblings (`delay={i * 70}`) for a cascading grid.

props.name: direction
props.doc: Which way the element travels into place. Default `up` (rises from below). `none` = fade only. Drives the pre-reveal offset via the `--cs-reveal-x` / `--cs-reveal-y` custom properties.

props.name: distance
props.doc: Offset magnitude in px for the pre-reveal state. Default 12. Ignored when `direction="none"`.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Cascade the DIRECT CHILDREN instead of this element: each child reveals `stagger` ms after the previous one (via `nth-child` `transition-delay` reading `--cs-reveal-stagger`). Use on a grid/list wrapper so its cards enter in sequence; the wrapper itself is not hidden. Children past the 6th share the last step (bounded — raise the ceiling in `reveal.css` if a grid grows).

props.name: style
props.doc: Extra inline styles, merged after the component's own custom-property style (e.g. a grid's `marginTop`). Lets a Reveal double as a layout container without a wrapping element.

a11yNotes: Reduced-motion users skip the observer and reveal immediately; without JavaScript, content remains visible rather than being trapped at `opacity: 0`.

components.name: Section
components.summary: a semantic page section with optional eyebrow, heading, lede, band, and flush-edge treatments. Recipe primitive (ADR-0099); purely presentational (no Radix), server-safe. 3. Variants as `data-*`: `data-flush` (boolean) drops the hairline, `data-band` tones the background — styled by attribute selectors, no variant logic in JS. 4. `forwardRef` onto the single `<section>` root; BEM block name `cs-section`. The `.cs-section` shell + its `data-*` variants are a shared layout primitive in base.css (Hero + pages reuse it); the type/layout classes (`cs-container` / `cs-eyebrow` / `cs-section-title` / `cs-lede`) likewise live in base.css. This component owns no co-located CSS — it is composition.

props.name: as
props.doc: Heading level for `title`. Use "h1" for a Section-led page's top header (one h1/page).

props.name: band
props.doc: Toned background band for section rhythm (V19).

props.name: flush
props.doc: Drop the top hairline (first section under the nav).

a11yNotes: The caller selects the heading level through `as`; the wrapper remains a native `section`.

components.name: Select
components.summary: a styled wrapper over the native `<select>`, so keyboard interaction, the native option list, type-ahead, and mobile pickers come for free (the free line). A caret glyph is drawn by CSS; the real control stays the native element. `aria-label` (or a wiring `<label>`) names it. The autocomplete/typeahead combobox is a heavier variant left to the commercial tier.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid` + danger chrome).

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Non-selectable leading hint rendered as a disabled empty option.

components.name: SkuMatrix
components.summary: SkuMatrix (V14 — editions × modules). Presentational; no Radix behavior needed. Recipe-compliant (ADR-0099): co-located CSS reading only `var(--cs-*)`, BEM block `cs-matrix`, `forwardRef` on the single DOM root (the scroll wrapper). The row-label weight that was an inline `style` in the old `apps/site` primitive is now the `.cs-matrix th[scope="row"]` rule.

props.name: columns
props.doc: Column headers (editions); the leading "Module" header is fixed.

props.name: rows
props.doc: One row per module; each row has a `label` and a cell per column.

components.name: StatusChip
components.summary: glyph + label status pill (ADR-0078 §7), never colour-alone.

props.name: dot
props.doc: Show the leading status dot (inherits `currentColor` from the resolved tone).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Optional leading glyph (Lucide / bespoke domain icon, via the one `<Icon>` surface).

props.name: label
props.doc: The chip text (always present — meaning is carried by label + glyph, never colour-alone).

props.name: tone
props.doc: Semantic tone → a local-indirection `--chip-fg` var (recipe rule 3); defaults to `muted`.

components.name: StatusPill
components.summary: entitlement/license status pill (active / expired / revoked / pending). Sibling to `StatusChip` (the generic glyph+label pill) but scoped to the adopter dashboard's entitlement domain, so callers get a typed `status` instead of a free `tone`. Never colour-alone: a status dot plus the always-present text label carry the meaning together.

props.name: children
props.doc: Override the label; omit for the default plain-English label.

props.name: status
props.doc: Which lifecycle state to render — drives the tone + default label.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: an on/off control for an immediate-effect setting (distinct from Checkbox, which is a form-submission value). Implemented as `<button role="switch" aria-checked>` per the WAI-ARIA Switch pattern (a `role="switch"` override on `<input type="checkbox">` is not reliably exposed by every AT, so the APG recommends the button build for JS-driven switches). Zero-Radix, zero dependencies (ADR-0291).

props.name: checked
props.doc: On/off state (controlled — the switch has no internal state, like the rest of the kit's controlled primitives).

props.name: label
props.doc: Trailing label text/content, rendered INSIDE the button so it feeds the button's normal accessible-name computation (a wrapping `<label>` is not reliably read by every AT for a `role="switch"` button). Omit for an icon-only switch and pass `aria-label` instead.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: a same-page panel switcher: `role="tablist"`/`role="tab"`/`role="tabpanel"` per the WAI-ARIA Tabs authoring pattern, automatic activation (arrow keys move focus AND select), roving `tabindex` (only the active tab is Tab-reachable), Home/End jump to the first/last enabled tab, disabled tabs are skipped. Zero-Radix, zero dependencies (ADR-0291).

props.name: aria-label
props.doc: Names the tablist for assistive tech when there is no adjacent visible heading.

props.name: value
props.doc: The active tab id — controlled, like the kit's other stateful primitives (`Dialog`, `Toast`).

components.name: Terminal
components.summary: the framed evidence artifact (a chrome bar + a monospace body). Purely presentational (no Radix, server-safe per recipe rule 1). Built to the ADR-0099 recipe: - Co-located plain CSS (`terminal.css`) reading only `var(--cs-*)`. - BEM block `cs-terminal` / elements `cs-terminal__bar` + `cs-terminal__body`. - `forwardRef` onto the single DOM root, matching the Button reference.

props.name: label
props.doc: Chrome-bar label; also mirrored to the `<pre>` `aria-label`.

props.name: status
props.doc: A `<StatusChip/>` or text rendered at the right of the chrome bar.

components.name: ThemeToggle
components.summary: an ICON control (no text), single button. 3-prong dark mode: before any click the document follows the OS via CSS (`prefers-color-scheme`); this toggle tracks that live and only PINS a choice on click (writes `data-theme` + localStorage). Paired with `themeInitScript` (theme-init.ts) for FOUC-free pinned loads. (ADR-0100 F3)
a11yNotes: The native `type="button"` control names the target mode ("Switch to light/dark theme"), so the icon-only affordance always has an accessible name.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: a single transient notification. `danger`/`warning` announce assertively (`role="alert"`), info/success politely (`role="status"`). Presentational + server-safe: the queue and auto-dismiss timers are the app's concern; mount toasts inside a `ToastRegion` so they share one live region.

props.name: onDismiss
props.doc: Render a dismiss button that calls this.

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional heading above the message.
